When choosing takes, lines or cut points from footage, follow [local footage review](../edit-video/SKILL.md#review-footage-locally) first.

Ask first, unless the request already answers it:

- Will they finish in CapCut desktop, web or the phone app?
- What should the finished cut be: length, aspect ratio, captions?

Before driving CapCut with computer-use, ask; "do it in CapCut" alone doesn't answer that.

Know:

- CapCut opens no project files from other editors. Hand off files: clips, voice-over and music
  as separate files, and captions as a UTF-8 SRT, in one project folder with a short note of the
  clip order, trims and where each audio file sits.
- SRT import works in CapCut desktop and web; the phone app can't import subtitle files.
- Cut, caption and voice the piece with edit-video and voiceover first, so CapCut only adds the
  finishing touches.
